mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news (title, content, user_id, create_time, media_type, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{mediaType}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE news SET is_deleted = '1', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM news
title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = '0') AND (status IS NULL OR status = 0)
ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news
title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = '0') AND (status IS NULL OR status = 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = '0') AND (status IS NULL OR status = 0)

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, u.avatar, u.user_account AS userAccount, n.like_count, n.comment_count, n.collect_count, n.create_time, (SELECT ni.image_url FROM news_image ni WHERE ni.news_id = n.id AND (ni.is_delete IS NULL OR ni.is_delete = '0') ORDER BY ni.sort_order ASC, ni.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS cover FROM news n JOIN user u ON u.id = n.user_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND (n.is_deleted IS NULL OR n.is_deleted = '0') AND (n.status IS NULL OR n.status = 0) AND (u.is_deleted IS NULL OR u.is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY n.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE news SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
